name: knos_meter
docs: Acceptance without escrow: a neutral on-chain count of evaluations that GitHub signed, paid from prepaid credits. It moves no customer money.
Upgradeable only through a multisig with a public 48-hour delay, until an outside review.
A native program: this file is written by hand from programs-v2/knos_meter/src (lib.rs lists every instruction, state.rs every account) and checked by tests/test_meter_chain.py.
Instruction data is the discriminant byte, then the arguments in order, little-endian, with no padding.
token is a VERIFIED GitHub Actions token account owned by knos-oidc (the second deployment's verifier), from a GitHub-hosted runner, at most an hour past its expiry,
issued no more than 300 seconds ahead of the chain's clock and living at most an hour. key, the account after it, is knos-oidc's account of the key that verified it
(the token account names it at bytes 18..50). It must be usable now (errors 76 to 78) and of a kind the meter knows: a private key counts nothing (122).
The audience (the aud claim): knosm:eval:<buyer owner id>:<seller id>:<work order hex32>:<artifact hex40>:<policy hex32>:<milestone>:<verdict 0|1>:<rate>,
from attest.yml or prove.yml of the repository the Credits account pins, at the commit it pins, run in a repository of the buyer, first attempt.
A billable evaluation is one (buyer, work order, artifact, policy, milestone): billed and counted once, whatever the verdict; a later token for it is free and changes nothing while its Mark stands.

The relayer puts up the Mark's rent and CloseMark returns all of it to that relayer from the Mark's closeAfter: the first second of the next UTC month plus 7200 seconds, when no token GitHub issued in the month of the count is accepted any more. A retry is free for the whole calendar month; after a Mark is closed, a token issued in a later month for the same evaluation is billed and counted again, in that month.

Prices in whole units of the mint, kept in millionths: 50000 (0.05) per billable evaluation, or the owner's Plan rate (20000..=50000) until its expiry; the first 10000 of an owner in a UTC month are free.
Anyone may relay Record and pay its gas. tokenProgram is SPL Token or Token-2022, the owner of the mint.

Batch mode (1.1): RecordBatch and ClaimBatch take one token for many evaluations and keep one Ledger per (buyer, seller, month); the evaluations themselves are in a ledger file off chain. The program cannot tell that an evaluation of a batch was also recorded by Record or in another batch; the ledger file shows it.

instructions.name: OpenCredits
docs: A wallet opens credits for the evaluations of one GitHub owner (the buyer) and pins the workflows whose runs may spend them. Sent again by the same wallet, it sets a new pin and nothing else. No money moves; add money with a plain token transfer to crtok.

instructions.name: Record
docs: Records the evaluation a verified token describes: counted and billed the first time, free and without effect after that while its Mark stands (logs knosm:retry). Credits that cannot pay the fee are refused (118) and nothing is recorded. The Mark keeps the relayer, who paid its rent, and the time from which CloseMark returns it.

instructions.name: CloseMark
docs: The relayer that paid a Mark's rent takes all of it back, from the Mark's closeAfter on (124 before it; 123 for another signer or another account). The Mark is gone (logs knosm:closed). Several fit in one transaction.

instructions.name: RecordBatch
docs: Anyone relays. One token for many evaluations: audience knosm:batch:<buyer owner id>:<seller id>:<month yyyymm>:<seq>:<count>:<accepted>:<value>:<root hex32>, from the pinned attest.yml or prove.yml, first attempt, run in a repository of the buyer. count 1..=100000, accepted <= count, month the chain's or the one before (126); seq must be the Ledger's nextSeq (125). No account per evaluation. The owner's count of the chain's month goes up by count; the part above the first 10000 costs the rate each, from crtok to feeToken, and credits that hold less refuse the whole batch (118). The Ledger adds the totals and sets chain = sha256(chain || root || seq || count || accepted || value), integers u64 LE (logs knosm:batch).

instructions.name: ClaimBatch
docs: Anyone relays. The seller's own count: audience knosm:claim:<buyer owner id>:<seller id>:<month yyyymm>:<seq>:<count>:<accepted>:<value>:<root hex32>, from any workflow run in a repository whose owner id is the seller (117). The same bounds (126) and seq rule (125) as RecordBatch. No fee, no credits. Writes the Ledger at ["lc", ...] as RecordBatch writes the one at ["l", ...] (logs knosm:claim).

instructions.name: Version
docs: Logs knosm:version 1.1. Simulate it to learn which build is live.

accounts.name: Credits
docs: PDA ["cr", ownerId u64 LE, authority, mint]: what a wallet prepaid for the evaluations of one GitHub owner. 168 bytes. version is 1.
tokenProgram 0 SPL Token, 1 Token-2022. spent: every fee it paid. evaluations: the billable evaluations recorded against it, the free ones included.
wfRepo: sha256 of the "owner/name" of the repository whose attest.yml and prove.yml may spend it; wfSha: their commit, 40 hex characters.

accounts.name: Plan
docs: PDA ["plan", ownerId u64 LE]: an owner's rate under a contract, and its billable evaluations this month. 40 bytes. version is 1.
rate: millionths of a whole unit per evaluation, in force before expiry (0: no plan). used counts the month `month` (yyyymm) and starts again when the month changes.

accounts.name: Mark
docs: PDA ["k", buyer id u64 LE, key]: this evaluation was billed. 88 bytes. version is 2. verdict 1 accepted, 0 rejected.
month: the yyyymm it was counted in. rate: the value its token declared. fee: what the credits paid for it.
payer: the relayer that paid its rent, the only signer CloseMark takes and the only address the rent goes to. closeAfter: the chain time from which it can be closed.
A mark written before CloseMark existed is the first 48 bytes with version 1: it stays, and nobody closes it.

accounts.name: Month
docs: PDA ["m", buyer id u64 LE, seller id u64 LE, yyyymm u32 LE]: the count of one buyer and one seller in one UTC month. 64 bytes. version is 1.
evaluations = accepted + rejected. value: the sum of rate over the accepted. fees: what these evaluations cost in credits.

accounts.name: Ledger
docs: PDA ["l", buyer id u64 LE, seller id u64 LE, yyyymm u32 LE] (kind 0: batches recorded by the buyer's runs) or ["lc", ...] (kind 1: batches claimed by the seller's runs). 96 bytes. version is 1. Never closed.

nextSeq: the seq the next batch must carry, and the number of batches so far. evaluations, accepted, value, fees: sums over the batches (fees is 0 in a claim). chain: 32 zero bytes, then sha256(chain || root || seq || count || accepted || value) for each batch, integers u64 LE.

root is the RFC 6962 Merkle root over the batch's evaluation keys (leaf sha256(0x00 || key), node sha256(0x01 || left || right)), keys sorted ascending and never repeated; the program stores it in the chain and never computes it.

errors.name: Json
errors.msg: The claim reader: the claims are not a JSON object

errors.name: Duplicate
errors.msg: The claim reader: a claim that was asked for appears twice

errors.name: Claim
errors.msg: The claim reader: a claim is missing or of the wrong type

errors.name: KeyInactive
errors.msg: The key that verified the token is not active yet

errors.name: KeyExpired
errors.msg: The key that verified the token has expired

errors.name: KeyRevoked
errors.msg: The key that verified the token was revoked

errors.name: Accounts
errors.msg: A wrong account, or a missing signature

errors.name: Terms
errors.msg: Owner id, workflow commit, rate or tier not allowed

errors.name: Credits
errors.msg: Not a Credits account, or the signer is not the wallet that opened it

errors.name: Token
errors.msg: The token is not verified by knos-oidc, not GitHub's, or expired

errors.name: Claims
errors.msg: The token's claims do not allow this: the runner, or a re-run instead of a first run

errors.name: Workflow
errors.msg: The token is not from attest.yml or prove.yml at the commit the Credits account pins

errors.name: Aud
errors.msg: The audience is not a knosm:eval audience

errors.name: Owner
errors.msg: The run was not in a repository of the buyer, or the credits are another owner's

errors.name: Funds
errors.msg: The credits do not hold that much

errors.name: Mint
errors.msg: The mint or the token program is not accepted

errors.name: Fee
errors.msg: feeToken is not a token account of the mint owned by FEE_OWNER, or destToken is not the authority's

errors.name: FeeOwner
errors.msg: Not FEE_OWNER

errors.name: KeyKind
errors.msg: The key that verified the token is private, or of a kind this program does not know

errors.name: Mark
errors.msg: Not a Mark that can be closed, or the signer is not the relayer that paid its rent

errors.name: Early
errors.msg: The Mark cannot be closed yet: its month has not closed, or a token issued in it could still be relayed

errors.name: Seq
errors.msg: The batch's seq is not the Ledger's next: this token was taken before, or a batch before it is missing

errors.name: Batch
errors.msg: A batch of no evaluations or of more than 100000, more accepted than counted, or a month that is neither this one nor the last
